answer: Price sybils quadratically by shared funding. Each identity commit-reveals the wallet that paid its join fee; the network walks that wallet's funding graph out to a fixed horizon and groups identities sharing one ancestor. The epoch seed acts as a beacon, sampling identities who must prove their ancestry on-chain. A cluster shares one payout slot, and its k-th member pays a fee of k squared base units. So a thousand clones behind one deposit pay ~330 million units and split one slot: the fable of one operator posing as a thousand ends at the horizon. An honest agent pays once.
